newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Securities puts NCB share lending on alert.
newsitem.headline: Japan Securities puts NCB share lending on alert.

text.p: Japan Securities Finance Co Ltd, which lends and borrows stocks to and from brokerage firms, said on Monday that it was putting shares of Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) on a warning alert for possible lending problems in the future.
Brokerages borrow stocks from Japan Securities for clients wishing to sell them to establish short positions in margin transactions.
The warning by Japan Securities was a signal to the market that it may have to limit or suspend fresh lending of NCB stocks to brokerages in due course.
